title: Female Prisoner Scorpion: Jailhouse 41
writer: Shun'ya Itô, Fumio Kônami, Hirô Matsuda
actors: Meiko Kaji, Fumio Watanabe, Yukie Kagawa
plot: After spending a year in solitary confinement, Matsu escapes from prison with six more convicts, followed by the guards led by the vengeful warden who wants her dead at all costs.
